how_it_works_page.title: How It Works
how_it_works_page.subtitle: The 5-step automated workflow connecting farmers to verified procurement centers without queues or manual delays.
how_it_works_page.step1_desc: Farmers select crop and estimated quantity. The system applies a 40/30/20/10 multi-factor formula (Price, Proximity, Slot, Wait Time) to recommend optimal centers.
how_it_works_page.step2_desc: Book a 30-minute slot instantly. The engine atomically checks both maximum farmer count and crop volume caps, generating a unique signed QR token.
how_it_works_page.step3_desc: Arrive at the center within -15 to +15 minutes of slot start. The operator scans your QR, ordering the queue by scheduled slot, then arrival time.
how_it_works_page.step4_desc: Crops are graded and weighed. Deductions are calculated with exact decimal arithmetic, issuing an immutable, traceable digital receipt.
how_it_works_page.step5_desc: Follow transparent payment progression (pending -> processing -> paid) with recorded reference details and audit timestamps.
